<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="catalog_script_client"><catalog_script_client action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>false</active><applies_catalog>true</applies_catalog><applies_extended>false</applies_extended><applies_req_item>false</applies_req_item><applies_sc_task>false</applies_sc_task><applies_target_record>false</applies_target_record><applies_to>item</applies_to><cat_item display_value="Book Metro Ticket">ba90939793eac710f6a4fcf08bba10af</cat_item><cat_variable>IO:d71117d793eac710f6a4fcf08bba1015</cat_variable><condition/><description/><field/><global>true</global><isolate_script>true</isolate_script><messages/><name>Auto Populate Passenger Contact</name><order/><published_ref/><script><![CDATA[function onChange(control, oldValue, newValue, isLoading) {
    if (isLoading) {
        return;
    }

    if (!newValue) {
        g_form.clearValue('email_address');
        g_form.clearValue('mobile_number');
        return;
    }

    g_form.getReference('passenger', function(user) {
        if (user) {
            g_form.setValue('email_address', user.email || '');
            g_form.setValue('mobile_number', user.mobile_phone || '');
        }
    });
}]]></script><sys_class_name>catalog_script_client</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-08-12 16:16:23</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>e1a33f1f93eec710f6a4fcf08bba10f5</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Auto Populate Passenger Contact</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Metro Ticket Generating System" source="x_2034419_metro_0">a345a91393928b10f6a4fcf08bba109b</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Metro Ticket Generating System">a345a91393928b10f6a4fcf08bba109b</sys_scope><sys_update_name>catalog_script_client_e1a33f1f93eec710f6a4fcf08bba10f5</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-08-12 17:02:16</sys_updated_on><table/><type>onChange</type><ui_type>0</ui_type><va_supported>true</va_supported><variable_set/><view/></catalog_script_client></record_update>
